title: Arabidopsis Atlas: a FAIR, literature-grounded interactive structural and expression atlas of Arabidopsis thaliana
description: An interactive, organ-selectable 3D atlas of Arabidopsis thaliana, built as a scientifically-grounded counterpart to the procedurally-generated rice-atlas viewer. Organ geometry cites peer-reviewed developmental-biology literature rather than being invented; a spaceflight-response layer, absent from the original, is computed directly from real NASA Open Science Data Repository (OSDR) count matrices for root (OSD-120) and whole-seedling (OSD-314) studies; developmental gene expression is linked to the real Klepikova/TraVA atlas rather than redistributed. Every number the viewer and accompanying manuscript display traces to a script-produced file in this repository, checked against this project's own pre-publication evidence gate before release.
